definitions.explanation: A person, typically a child, who cries frequently or easily. Can be used teasingly or descriptively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧なきむしだった⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I was a crybaby when I was little, but now I've become strong.

notes:
なきむし describes a person (usually a child) who cries frequently or easily. Can also be written in kanji as {泣|な}き{虫|むし}.

FORMS:
{泣|な}き (crying, from ⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧) + ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧ (bug). The むし suffix creates personality-type words implying the person is "infested" with the trait.

THE ～{虫|むし} PATTERN:
- なきむし/{泣|な}き{虫|むし}: crybaby
- ⟦{弱虫|よわむし}→弱虫：20009_yowamushi⟧: coward, weakling
- ⟦{怠|なま}け→怠ける：02379_namakeru⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧: lazybones
- {泣|な}き{虫|むし}: crybaby (same as なきむし)

USAGE:
Most commonly used among children as a mild taunt. Adults may use it self-deprecatingly (⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧なきむしだった — I was a crybaby as a kid). Not strongly offensive but can sting depending on context.

RELATED PERSONALITY WORDS:
- ⟦{甘|あま}えん{坊|ぼう}→甘えん坊：19928_amaenbou⟧: clingy/spoiled person
- ⟦{意気地|いくじ}なし→意気地なし：15798_ikujinashi⟧: coward, gutless person
- ⟦{照|て}れ{屋|や}→照れ屋：18529_tereya⟧: easily embarrassed person
